items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Van Allen was there. I.... we went down to the party and everything like that.

ctx.x: They gave big parties for us.

Pearl Mesta was there. I stayed down at the Lorillards Buena Vista. Van Allen was there. I.... we went down to the party and everything like that. But you were there. You were playing; Buck Clayton was playing. Lester Young was there. Billie Holiday was there, you see.

Ray Brown was there. I remember flying up first Festival that was the very there with Teddy Wilson in a small plane... I can't remember what year that was in, but we were there. It's a matter of record.
